test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Spot the part of the sentence that contains an error.

If there is no error, choose D.

A. She must have left

B. the office early yesterday

C. because she looks very tired today.

D. No error
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence shows a mismatch in tense and logical consistency between the clauses.
 
• The phrase "**must have left**" indicates a past deduction, referring to a completed action.
 
• However, "**looks very tired today**" refers to a present condition, which creates inconsistency when linked directly with a specific past time marker "**yesterday**".
 
• This inconsistency makes **part C** incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **C**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She must have left the office early because she **looked** very tired today."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "She must have left"** – This part is grammatically correct and properly expresses past deduction.
 
• **B: "the office early yesterday"** – This part is also correct and clearly indicates time.
 
• **D: "No error"** – This option is incorrect because there is an error in part C.
